RWA.note: The slides cover government websites and name no authentication service in Rwanda.
Sovereignty is argued for open-source adoption in general; no Rwandan rule, hosting or contract terms on state data are stated.
No electronic transactions or e-commerce law is mentioned.
No international standards membership, adoption or rule is mentioned.

facts.fact: The TYPO3 Association's FOSDEM 2024 slides state that a national functional and technical support center for the over 300 Rwandan government websites on the shared TYPO3 platform is operated by RISA.

RWA.note: Disaster recovery and backups appear only as a principle for government websites; no backup site or place is named.
A national website standard is mentioned but no standards body, issued IT standard or certification is stated.
